canonical_example.text: El payaso tenía una peluca púrpura.
canonical_example.translation: The clown was wearing a purple wig.

canonical_example.text: El púrpura es el color de la realeza.
canonical_example.translation: Purple is the color of royalty.

canonical_example.text: El paciente tiene el pie derecho tiene manchas de púrpura.
canonical_example.translation: The patient's right leg is covered in purpura spots.

canonical_example.text: La tela fue teñida con púrpura.
canonical_example.translation: The fabric was dyed with Tyrian purple.

canonical_example.text: Las púrpuras viven entre rocas y corales.
canonical_example.translation: Murexes live among corals and rocks.

canonical_example.text: El biólogo tenía un fósil de una concha de púrpura sobre su escritorio.
canonical_example.translation: The biologist had a fossil shell of a rock snail on his desk.

canonical_example.text: ¡Quítate esa capa! Solo el emperador puede vestir la púrpura.
canonical_example.translation: Take off that cape! Only the emperor may wear the purple.

canonical_example.text: ¡Apúrate que ya estamos atrasados!
canonical_example.translation: Hurry up, we're already late!

canonical_example.text: Estoy atrasado con las metas de este proyecto.
canonical_example.translation: I'm behind on achieving this project's goals.

canonical_example.text: Estás atrasado con la renta. ¿Cuándo me vas a pagar?
canonical_example.translation: You're overdue on the rent. When are you going to pay me?

canonical_example.text: Señor Donaldo, está atrasado. Recibí su último pago mensual hace dos meses.
canonical_example.translation: Mr. Donaldo. You are in arrears. I received your last monthly payment two months ago.

canonical_example.text: La oposición de los vecinos atrasó la construcción de la gasolinera
canonical_example.translation: Opposition from neighbours delayed construction of the gas station.

canonical_example.text: El vuelo a París salió 15 minutos atrasado.
canonical_example.translation: The flight to Paris left 15 minutes behind schedule.

canonical_example.text: Para gozar de sus privilegios como socio del club, debe ponerse al día con todos los pagos atrasados.
canonical_example.translation: In order to enjoy your privileges as a club member, you must get up to date with all your outstanding payments.

canonical_example.text: A pesar de ser un país atrasado en muchos aspectos, tiene sus encantos.
canonical_example.translation: Despite being a backward country in many aspects, it has its charms.

canonical_example.text: Estás tan atrasado. ¡Toma la foto con el teléfono!
canonical_example.translation: You are so behind the times. Take the picture with your phone!

canonical_example.text: No quise llegar tarde. Creo que mi reloj ha de estar atrasado.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't mean to arrive late. I think my watch must be slow.

canonical_example.text: Las regiones más atrasadas carecen de una infraestructura moderna y transporte público.
canonical_example.translation: The most backward regions lack modern infrastructure and public transportation.

canonical_example.text: Llévala a un especialista. Si no camina a los 18 meses, está atrasada.
canonical_example.translation: Take her to a specialist. If she isn't walking at 18 months, she's slow.

canonical_example.text: Los novios atrasaron su boda por cuestiones de salud.
canonical_example.translation: The bride and groom postponed their wedding for health reasons.

canonical_example.text: Tendremos que atrasar la construcción hasta conseguir los permisos.
canonical_example.translation: We'll have to delay construction until we get the permits.

canonical_example.text: Tuvimos que atrasar la fiesta de compromiso porque mi padre sufrió un infarto.
canonical_example.translation: We had to put back the engagement party because my father had a heart attack.

canonical_example.text: La manifestación atrasó el tráfico.
canonical_example.translation: The traffic was held up by the demonstration.

canonical_example.text: El domingo tenemos que atrasar nuestros relojes una hora.
canonical_example.translation: We need to put our clocks back by an hour on Sunday.

canonical_example.text: El reloj de la cocina atrasa; tendremos que cambiarle la pila.
canonical_example.translation: The kitchen clock's slow; we'll need to change the batteries.

canonical_example.text: Mi reloj atrasó sin que me diera cuenta y llegué tarde a la cita.
canonical_example.translation: My watch was losing time without my realizing it, so I was late for the appointment.

canonical_example.text: Este reloj atrasa venticinco segundos al día.
canonical_example.translation: This clock loses twenty-five seconds a day.

canonical_example.text: Tu despertador atrasa. No son las 5:15, son las 5:20.
canonical_example.translation: Your alarm clock runs slow. It's not 5:15, it's 5:20.

canonical_example.text: Susana se atrasó en sus estudios y no ha terminado la carrera.
canonical_example.translation: Susana fell behind with her studies so she hasn't finished her degree.

canonical_example.text: Los inquilinos se atrasaron en el pago de la renta el mes pasado.
canonical_example.translation: The tenants got behind with their rent last month.

canonical_example.text: El camión se atrasó tanto que nos tuvimos que ir en taxi.
canonical_example.translation: The bus was so late that we had to take a taxi instead.

canonical_example.text: Emilia se atrasó porque se le ponchó una llanta.
canonical_example.translation: Emilia was delayed because she had a flat tire.

canonical_example.text: Me atrasé en el trabajo y perdí el tren.
canonical_example.translation: I got held up at work and missed my train.

canonical_example.text: Llegué tarde al examen porque mi reloj se atrasó.
canonical_example.translation: I was late for the exam because my watch was slow.

canonical_example.text: Este reloj se atrasa a pesar de que le cambié la pila la semana pasada.
canonical_example.translation: This clock is losing time despite my changing the battery last week.

canonical_example.text: Este reloj se atrasa diez minutos al día.
canonical_example.translation: This clock loses ten minutes a day.

canonical_example.text: A María se le atrasó la menstruación y resultó que estaba embarazada.
canonical_example.translation: María's period was late, and it turned out she was pregnant.

canonical_example.text: Supongo que es normal atrasarse durante la perimenopausia.
canonical_example.translation: I guess it's normal to have late periods during the perimenopause.

canonical_example.text: La tormenta vino con muchos truenos.
canonical_example.translation: The storm brought a lot of thunder.

canonical_example.text: Eso fue el trueno más fuerte que jamás he escuchado.
canonical_example.translation: That was the loudest clap of thunder I've ever heard.

canonical_example.text: El trueno de los fuegos pirotécnicos fue estupendo.
canonical_example.translation: The thunder from the fireworks was awesome.

canonical_example.text: El trueno la despertó violentamente.
canonical_example.translation: The thunderclap jolted her awake.

canonical_example.text: El trueno del cañón se escuchó a kilómetros de distancia.
canonical_example.translation: The cannon's boom was heard kilometers away.

canonical_example.text: Oímos el trueno de los cascos mucho antes de que viéramos la estampida.
canonical_example.translation: We heard the thundering of hooves long before we saw the stampede.

canonical_example.text: Estuvo tronando toda la noche.
canonical_example.translation: It was thundering all night.

canonical_example.text: Los cañones tronaban sin cesar.
canonical_example.translation: The guns thundered incessantly.

canonical_example.text: Escuché los tambores del desfile tronando.
canonical_example.translation: I heard the parade drums booming.

canonical_example.text: Parece que un cohete tronó entre la muchedumbre y se desató el pánico.
canonical_example.translation: A rocket seemingly went off in the crowd, which was thrown into a panic.

canonical_example.text: El globo tronó al tocar el calefactor.
canonical_example.translation: The balloon burst when it touched the heater.

canonical_example.text: "¿Qué quieres decir?", tronó mi padre.
canonical_example.translation: "What do you mean?," roared my father.

canonical_example.text: Mi jefe tronó: "¡Eres un incompetente!".
canonical_example.translation: My boss thundered: "You're completely incompetent!"

canonical_example.text: Ana tronaba contra todos en la oficina.
canonical_example.translation: Ana raged against everyone at the office.

canonical_example.text: La señora Cruz tronaba contra la corrupción de los partidos más importantes.
canonical_example.translation: Mrs Cruz was ranting about corruption in the major political parties.

canonical_example.text: El cura seguía tronando contra quienes cometen adulterio.
canonical_example.translation: The priest was still railing against people who commit adultery.

canonical_example.text: Una de las víctimas tronaba contra la policía por hacer mal su trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: One of the victims complained bitterly about the police for not doing their job properly.

canonical_example.text: Muchos tronaron cuando el banco quebró.
canonical_example.translation: Many were ruined when the bank went bust.

canonical_example.text: Los socios tronaron por descuidar el negocio.
canonical_example.translation: The partners went bankrupt through neglect of their business.

canonical_example.text: Valeria tronó con el vecino por la música estrepitosa que pone.
canonical_example.translation: Valeria fell out with her neighbor over the loud music he plays.

canonical_example.text: Mario tronó en su primer salto.
canonical_example.translation: Mario failed in his first jump.

canonical_example.text: Gaby está triste porque tronó con su novio.
canonical_example.translation: Gaby's sad because she broke up with her boyfriend.

canonical_example.text: Ricardo está inconsolable desde que tronó con su novia.
canonical_example.translation: Ricardo has been inconsolable since he split up with his girlfriend.

canonical_example.text: ¿Por qué tronaste el globo?
canonical_example.translation: Why did you pop the balloon?

canonical_example.text: A mi hermano le encanta tronar globos.
canonical_example.translation: My brother loves bursting balloons.

canonical_example.text: Tom tronó los fuegos artificiales a la medianoche.
canonical_example.translation: Tom set off the fireworks at midnight.

canonical_example.text: Troné el examen de física otra vez.
canonical_example.translation: I failed the physics exam again.

canonical_example.text: Si te truenan en más de dos materias te suspenden del colegio.
canonical_example.translation: If they flunk you in more than two subjects you get suspended from school.

canonical_example.text: Los criminales tronaron a su rehén.
canonical_example.translation: The criminals shot their hostage.

canonical_example.text: Hugo, el jefe de recursos humanos, tronó a tres trabajadores.
canonical_example.translation: Hugo, the head of human resources, fired three employees.

canonical_example.text: Algunos creen que tronarse los dedos puede causar artritis.
canonical_example.translation: Some people think that snapping your fingers may cause arthritis.

canonical_example.text: Luis se tronó a la señora de la tienda.
canonical_example.translation: Luis had sex with the lady at the store.

canonical_example.text: Pensó en tronarse al ver el daño que había causado.
canonical_example.translation: He thought about shooting himself when he saw the damage he'd caused.

canonical_example.text: Los Institutos Nacionales de la Salud recomiendan vacunarse contra la epidemia de gripe.
canonical_example.translation: The National Institutes of Health recommend to get vaccinated against the influenza epidemic.

canonical_example.text: Cualquiera puede intentar hacer su propio jardín en casa.
canonical_example.translation: Anybody can try to make their own home garden.

canonical_example.text: No intentes cambiar el foco sin una escalera.
canonical_example.translation: Don't attempt to change the lightbulb without a ladder.

canonical_example.text: Mis intentos no tuvieron el resultado deseado.
canonical_example.translation: My attempts didn't have the desired result.

canonical_example.text: Pasó el examen de manejar al primer intento.
canonical_example.translation: He passed his driving test on the first attempt.

canonical_example.text: Lo acusaron de intento de soborno.
canonical_example.translation: He was accused of attempted bribery.

canonical_example.text: Mi intento era ayudarte, no hacerte enojar.
canonical_example.translation: My intention was to help you, not to make you angry.

canonical_example.text: El intento de la asociación es procurar un hogar a personas que viven en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: The aim of the association is to secure a home for people living on the streets.

canonical_example.text: Sugiero que te vayas a dormir ya; es tarde.
canonical_example.translation: I suggest you go to sleep now. It's late.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué emociones sugieren estos cuadros?
canonical_example.translation: What emotions do these pictures evoke?

canonical_example.text: La comida que cocinaste me sugiere la cocina auténtica italiana.
canonical_example.translation: The meal you cooked reminds me of authentic Italian cuisine.

canonical_example.text: El artículo sugiere la posibilidad de que las elecciones se vuelvan a repetir por sospecha de fraude.
canonical_example.translation: The article hints at the possibility that there will be a rerun of the election because of suspected fraud.

canonical_example.text: Los vendedores a menudo tienen que tolerar a clientes enojados o irrespetuosos.
canonical_example.translation: Sales clerks often have to tolerate angry or rude customers.

canonical_example.text: Mi jefa no tolera que le lleven la contraria.
canonical_example.translation: My boss cannot stand to be contradicted.

canonical_example.text: Una de las primeras cosas que hay que aprender en la vida es a tolerar ideas distintas de las nuestras.
canonical_example.translation: One of the first things we must learn in life is to tolerate ideas that are different from our own.

canonical_example.text: Baja el volumen de la computadora. No puedo tolerar ese ruido.
canonical_example.translation: Turn down the computer volume. I can't bear that noise.

canonical_example.text: Me voy. No tengo por qué tolerar esto de nadie.
canonical_example.translation: I'm off. I don't have to put up with this from anyone.

canonical_example.text: Yo no le tolero a un mocoso como tú que me hable así.
canonical_example.translation: I won't tolerate a snot-nosed kid like you speaking to me like that.

canonical_example.text: Con un niño hay que tener mano firme, y desde luego no se le puede tolerar todo.
canonical_example.translation: You have to be firm with kids, and you obviously can't let them get away with everything.

canonical_example.text: Los maestros se han propuesto no tolerar a los alumnos ningún tipo de violencia.
canonical_example.translation: Teachers are determined not to allow pupils to engage in any kind of violence.

canonical_example.text: De momento, la paciente tolera bien la quimioterapia.
canonical_example.translation: The patient has tolerated the chemotherapy well so far.

canonical_example.text: Pedro es responsable y trabajador.
canonical_example.translation: Pedro is responsible and hardworking.

canonical_example.text: Mi plomero es trabajador y responsable; lo recomiendo mucho.
canonical_example.translation: My plumber is hard-working and responsible; I highly recommend him.

canonical_example.text: La mayoría de los niños trabajadores de Quito son limpiabotas.
canonical_example.translation: The majority of the working boys in Quito are shoeshiners.

canonical_example.text: Los trabajadores del turno de noche tienen que dormir de día.
canonical_example.translation: Night workers have to sleep during the daytime.

canonical_example.text: Mis trabajadores roban material de oficina de la empresa.
canonical_example.translation: My employees are stealing office supplies from the company.

canonical_example.text: El buque mercante chocó contra un iceberg y se hundió.
canonical_example.translation: The merchant ship hit an iceberg and sank.

canonical_example.text: El rey prohibió la entrada de buques británicos a cualquier puerto del imperio francés.
canonical_example.translation: The king banned the entrance of British shipping into any port of the French empire.

canonical_example.text: ¡Necesito jama! Cocíname algo, porfa.
canonical_example.translation: I need food! Cook something for me, please.

canonical_example.text: Los invitados jamaron plato tras plato hasta acabar el menú.
canonical_example.translation: The guests stuffed themselves with every dish on the menu.

canonical_example.text: Tenía tanta hambre que no podía dejar de jamar cuando llegamos al banquete.
canonical_example.translation: I was so starving that I couldn't stop stuffing myself when we arrived at the banquet.

canonical_example.text: ¡La pizza que se jamaron mis dos hermanos era enorme!
canonical_example.translation: The pizza my two brothers stuffed themselves with was huge!

canonical_example.text: Solo deseo hacerte feliz.
canonical_example.translation: I just want to make you happy.

canonical_example.text: El director desea hablar con usted.
canonical_example.translation: The director wishes to speak to you.

canonical_example.text: Los discursos del presidente dejan mucho que desear.
canonical_example.translation: The president's speeches leave a lot to be desired.

canonical_example.text: Les deseé muchos años de felicidad.
canonical_example.translation: I wished them many years of happiness.

canonical_example.text: "Te deseo", dijo el rompecorazones de la película.
canonical_example.translation: "I want you," said the heartbreaker in the movie.

canonical_example.text: "¿Qué desea?", preguntó el mayordomo.
canonical_example.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.

canonical_example.text: Acerqué las plantas a la ventana.
canonical_example.translation: I moved the plants closer to the window.

canonical_example.text: La tragedia me acercó a mi familia.
canonical_example.translation: The tragedy brought me closer to my family.

canonical_example.text: Mi primo me va a acercar al aeropuerto por la mañana.
canonical_example.translation: My cousin is going to take me to the airport in the morning.

canonical_example.text: ¿Viniste en coche? - Sí. Mi mamá me acercó.
canonical_example.translation: Did you come by car? - Yes. My mom brought me.

canonical_example.text: Acércate al perro con cuidado porque podría ser rabioso.
canonical_example.translation: Approach the dog carefully, because it might be rabid.

canonical_example.text: El libro me hizo acercarme a la política exterior.
canonical_example.translation: The book made me take an interest in foreign policy.

canonical_example.text: Necesito acercarme al dentista pronto.
canonical_example.translation: I need to go to the dentist soon.
